steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Uploads tab.
Compare: only files you uploaded are listed. Upload a file first with the Add to the library control if none exist.
S24.02.where: Sidebar > Library > Uploads tab (under the Filter the library tabs)

S24.03.needs: an account that has generated files
steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Generated files tab.
Compare: only files the assistant generated are listed.

S24.04.note: The code also has a surface=artifact route that opens this tab directly.
steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Artifacts tab.
Click one artifact tile to open it.
Compare: the list shows your artifacts and the chosen one opens.
Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Images tab.
Click an image tile; the viewer opens with the file name in its label.
Compare: each image opens in the viewer and zoom buttons change the size.
Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Videos tab.
Click a video tile to open it.
Compare: the video plays in the viewer.

S24.08.note: Searched the composer files menu (apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ComposerFilesMenu.tsx) and the Library view for a recent-files view. Found only fetchRecentLibraryFiles, with no visible label or section for recent files.

steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Click the List view icon at the top right.
Compare: files show as rows.
Click the Grid view icon.
Compare: files show as tiles.
S24.12.where: Sidebar > Library > Library layout buttons (Grid view / List view, top right)

steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Click the box that says Search files and projects.
Type part of a file name.
Compare: only files whose names match are listed.

S24.14.needs: files of more than one type in the Library
steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Images tab, then the Videos tab, then the Documents tab.
Compare: each tab lists only that file type.
S24.14.where: Sidebar > Library > Images, Videos or Documents tab

S24.15.needs: uploaded and generated files in the Library
S24.15.note: Upload and generated filters exist. No connector or provider filter was found in the Library tabs.
steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Uploads tab, then the Generated files tab.
Compare: each tab lists only files from that source.
Look for a connector or provider filter. None was found in the tabs.
S24.15.where: Sidebar > Library > Uploads or Generated files tab

steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Click the sort button (it shows Modified).
Click Name, then Size, then Type.
Compare: the list order changes for each choice.
S24.19.where: Sidebar > Library > Sort button (shows Modified) > Name, Size or Type

S24.27.needs: a project and a file that can be attached
steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Open the actions menu on a file that can be attached (for example a text file).
Click Add to project and choose a project.
Compare: a toast says Added to <project name>, and the file appears in the project's files.
S24.27.where: Sidebar > Library > file's actions menu (the Actions for button) > Add to project

S24.28.needs: a file in the Library and a model that accepts attachments
steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Open the actions menu on a file and click Add to chat.
Compare: a new chat opens with the file attached.
If the model cannot take attachments, the chat shows an error instead.
S24.28.where: Sidebar > Library > file's actions menu > Add to chat

S24.29.needs: a file that came from a conversation
S24.29.note: The Open chat item appears only for files that have a conversation.
steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Open the actions menu on a file that came from a conversation.
Click Open chat.
Compare: the conversation the file came from opens.
S24.29.where: Sidebar > Library > file's actions menu > Open chat

steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Look under the Library title for the storage line.
Compare: it reads like 'X of Y file storage used' when a limit is known, or 'X of file storage used' when not.
S24.33.where: Sidebar > Library > header text under the Library title

steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Open the actions menu on a file and click Delete. Confirm in the dialog.
Click the trash icon labelled Recently deleted.
Open the actions menu on the file and click Restore.
Compare: the file moves back to the Library. Recently deleted explains files stay for 30 days.
S24.34.where: Sidebar > Library > Recently deleted (trash icon) > file's actions menu > Restore

S24.35.needs: a file whose data is missing or cannot load
S24.35.note: The unavailable note appears only after a file fails to load. No expiry date is shown for normal files. The Kept until text appears in Recently deleted.
steps: Sign in and click Library in the sidebar.
Find a file that cannot be loaded (for example after its asset is removed).
Click it.
Compare: the entry shows 'This file is unavailable right now. Try again later, or remove this entry.'
S24.35.where: Sidebar > Library > a file tile or row that cannot load
